capabilities: Render 2D structures from smiles, mol, sdf, rxn, and auto-detecting chem code fences
Lay out multiple molecules per block as responsive grids with captions
Annotate stereochemistry with toggleable R/S and E/Z labels
Recolor rendered SVGs live for light and dark themes
Report invalid structures as inline errors without blocking other lines
extras: Desktop-only and requires Obsidian 1.4.0 or later; the RDKit WebAssembly binary is inlined into main.js (~3 MB). Pre-release versions can be tested via BRAT.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to render chemical structures inline from plain-text formats like SMILES or molfiles.

relations.evidence: It uses RDKit.js, which runs locally, so nothing is uploaded.

summary: Chemical structure renderer that draws 2D depictions of SMILES, molfile, SDF, and reaction inputs from fenced code blocks using RDKit.js.
